openings.claim: Bolted strip guides and pivoting retaining straps mechanically capture nonworking margins with opposing contact stops in existing slots; release straps for gloved inspection. Replace magnetic-attraction/pad-friction dependency. Allocate four strips, supplied bolts and cork contacts; drill strips only and plier-form guides and accessible release tabs.
openings.discriminator: Nearest rival: magnet-assisted friction clamp, whose magnetic holding differs between plates. Geometric capture should retain either despite that difference: the spare stays within 1 mm with stops engaged and magnetic assistance absent. Hypothesis, not demonstrated performance; weaker magnetic pull alone does not predict stroke slip. Fitness checks alone cannot exclude friction as the operating cause.
openings.probe: Ruler-measure slots, margins and clearance; sketch stops/removal path. Proceed only if strips form and M4 bolts fit without carriage disassembly or forbidden modifications. Keep rails attached, 30 mm edge exposed and additions outside marked clearance; never drill/cut/heat/glue plate or carriage. Fabricate within eighty minutes. Within twenty observation minutes, test one configuration in three twenty-stroke runs, spare last. Mark away from working edge; measure displacement. Perform three timed removal/return checks, thick gloves last; handle nonworking margins only. Require every run within 1 mm and every check within sixty seconds; check returned position. Observe stop contact, bolt loosening and clearance interference.
openings.uncertainty: Unresolved: slots accepting bolts/supporting stop geometry; strip thickness permitting plier forming and resisting unspecified stroke loads; margins accommodating opposing stops, top restraint and accessible gloved release outside clearance. Defeat: guide flexure, inadequate slot travel, inaccessible fasteners, interference or displacement/time failure. Resource caps require abandoning an unbuildable candidate.

lineage.reason: Mechanical relation, full rival prediction, probe, uncertainty and declared uncertain fit preserved.

decision: Retain one feasibility-gated probe candidate. Unknown geometry, strip properties and loads permit no constraint relaxation or deployment claim.
